facts.fact: Digital Mag lists several Tier III data centres in service at VITIB Grand-Bassam that host or colocate for other organisations, including RAXIO (inaugurated 24 September 2024), MainOne (inaugurated 9 November 2023), DataConnect, ST Digital (inaugurated 2 October 2025) and Kaydan Technology.
facts.system: RAXIO, MainOne, DataConnect, ST Digital and Kaydan data centres

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports the Ministry of Digital Transition is building a national data centre at VITIB Grand-Bassam, due by end-2026, with a 26 billion FCFA investment and Tier 3 certification.
Digital Mag reports five public data centres managed by ANSUT, including SNDI's, the Presidency's and the education ministry's, host sensitive state data and support e-government services.

CIV.note: The 26 billion FCFA national data centre figure is not tied to a budget line or its source.
Nothing on the national ID system.

facts.fact: Digital Mag says MainOne opened its first data centre in Cote d'Ivoire in 2019 with the installation of its submarine cable.

CIV.note: Certifications named belong to companies; nothing on the standards body.

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports ANSUT manages five public data centres, among them SNDI's, which is the central hosting point for the public administration.
Digital Mag reports the state SNDI data centre offers shared services to private companies, and the VITIB public data centre offers colocation space to public entities and approved companies.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres

facts.fact: Digital Mag describes the SNDI (Societe nationale de developpement informatique) and VITIB data centres as public data centres managed by ANSUT.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports SNDI's data centre is the central hosting point for the public administration, and the public data centres host sensitive data and e-government services.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres
